commits.message:
refactor(renderer): the renderer side is a directory, and a zones lint run both ways holds its seam (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.fro)

A table of zones in eslint.config.mjs (renderer, its start, shared, rest,
roots; the longest prefix wins) and an inline rule fail any import into
src/renderer/ but its start and any import out of it but shared code. It
certifies import direction only.

The contract moves to src/renderer-interface/ (interface, request context,
session-state and history ports, adapter). The renderer's modules move under
src/renderer/: the verb table, the render cache and its budget, payload
assembly, session state, the histories, render warnings, debug. Pure modules
both sides name move into src/daemon/foundations/ or join the shared row.

AdapterToHost lists what the renderer reaches in the host and is handed in
at the start; AdapterToRenderer lists what the host reaches in the renderer
and is returned beside `answer`. Each entry carries its
[LAW:effects-at-boundaries] exception. The main renderer loads its storage
where the daemon did and starts once the host's parts exist, so construction
order stays. The foundations rule and its test fold into the zones rule and
its test.
docs(spec): a file the renderer opens itself is not an adapter entry; the step that removes it adds its rule (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.fro)

chore(testing): remove the e2e-signoff hook (candybar-testing-ihvy.ums) (#745)

* chore(testing): remove the e2e-signoff hook; the sign-off file and the cap and assertion checks stay (candybar-testing-ihvy.ums)

The hook refused any tool call whose text named a guarded path, read-only
ones included, so it blocked agents' ordinary work. The checks it guarded
are what CI enforces, and they are unchanged.

* chore(testing): drop the removed hook from the required-CI-steps comment (candybar-testing-ihvy.ums)
